applies_to: Every diagnosis, every design gate, every finding triage. Evaluated FIRST, before any other class. The answer vocabulary is exactly that guard set (the R1 three-plane guard extended by the seam-map atlas §7 truth/projection split); the content/standing two-plane split is the policy-registry spec's own established sense, and "dataplane" is a proper noun — both stand. The ceremony's four substrate families and the matrix's §7 column grouping are DIFFERENT axes and are never called planes.

instances: 2026-07-09 content-head-election-vs-reach-fork-arbitration record — head/version read as reach/audience; the operator ontology-guard deleted content_head_election.rs rather than let an authority mechanism answer a reach question
2026-07-31 R1 decision (same record) — declared_at is the RECEIVING conductor's clock: truth-plane arbitration (notarized DHT link timestamp) and projection-plane divergence are not the same question
2026-08-02 ceremony mining — a landing-page divergence repeatedly read as head election when it was replication/custody

statement: Before any concern binds, the symptom names its plane — custody/availability · reach/audience · head/version, plus the truth-vs-projection distinction. A cure applied to the wrong plane is a defect even when locally correct.
title: Plane location — name the plane before binding any concern
why: This is the one class a SHARP AUTHORITY CANON ACTIVELY WORSENS: eight authority-flavoured concerns make every symptom look like an authority problem, so C0 is evaluated before them and its answer is recorded on the finding. Reach (audience, earned) != content_head (version, declared) != replication (availability, custody) — three orthogonal planes; and REA's monotonicity guard living in the PROJECTION rather than in DHT truth is exactly where C0 and C2 meet. Authority split with the seam-map atlas: the atlas §4 concern-routing table remains the ROUTING authority (where a concern lives); this canon is the GUARANTEE authority (what must hold). When they disagree, route by the atlas, then correct whichever recorded the world wrong.
